snippet.title: Doom wad - UnAligned (level 1)
snippet.description:
https://www.doomworld.com/idgames/levels/doom/megawads/unalign
===========================================================================
Advanced engine needed  : none
Primary purpose         : Single Player
===========================================================================
Title                   : UnAligned: 21 Days, 27 Maps, Zero Texture Alignment
Filename                : unalign.wad
Release date            : December 16, 2016
Author                  : Ryath/scwiba
Email Address           : [redacted]
Other Files By Author   : Absolutely Killed (killed.zip)
     Tower of Lies (lies.zip)

Misc. Author Info       : Was finally forced to switch to Doom Builder 2
     because his work computer won't run 1.68 :(

Description             : Three episodes of classic, vanilla Doom created
     in exactly 21 days, that attempt to capture some
     of the essence of 1990s mapping. Bite-sized,
     unconventional, and intentionally under-detailed.

Additional Credits to   : id Software
     CodeImp, SlayeR, exl, and Visual Vincent --
    creators of Doom Builder, SLADE, WhackEd 4
    and Doom Writer
     TITLEPIC font, "You Murderer", by Nate Piekos
     Playtesters:
    NoisyVelvet
    rdwpa
    rodster
    Albertoni
    AnonimVio
    walter confalonieri
    Voltcom9
    
===========================================================================
* What is included *

New levels              : 27
Sounds                  : No
Music                   : No
Graphics                : No
Dehacked/BEX Patch      : Included in WAD
Demos                   : Yes
Other                   : No
Other files required    : None


* Play Information *

Game                    : DOOM
Map #                   : E1M1-E3M9
Single Player           : Designed for
Cooperative 2-4 Player  : Starts only (untested)
Deathmatch 2-4 Player   : No
Other game styles       : None
Difficulty Settings     : Yes


* Construction *

Base                    : New from scratch
Build Time              : November 10th through 30th, 2016, with play-
     testing and polishing for the first half of
     December
Editor(s) used          : Doom Builder 1.68 and 2.1.2.1553, SLADE3,
     WhackEd 4, Doom Writer, MSPaint
Known Bugs              : 1) E2M8 relies on infinitely tall barrels as a
     barrier. Any ports that allow walking over
     other actors will make the "exit" accessible
     before intended.
     2) Some enemies flicker in and out in ports that
     cap the number of sprites onscreen at once.
     Most obvious in E3M6.
Tested With             : Chocolate Doom


* Map List *

 E1: Drafty Stations
  M1 - Infight Central
  M2 - 100 Linedefs Minus 1
  M3 - Toxin Refinerer
  M4 - Always Be Shooting
  M5 - Sgt. SLADDER
  M6 - 128 in 1024
  M7 - There And Back Again
  M8 - Sympathy for the Devil

  M9 - Nov 13, 2016

 E2: The Less-Loved Moon
  M1 - Energize!
  M2 - They're Watching
  M3 - 100 Linedefs Plus 1
  M4 - Not a Crate Maze
  M5 - Cryostasis Station
  M6 - Deimos City
  M7 - Heck Tech
  M8 - Rocket League
   
  M9 - Doomer-Friendly WAD-Shifter

 E3: Infernal Eternal
  M1 - Gatehouse
  M2 - 100 Linedefs Times 1
  M3 - Shrine of the Cacodemon
  M4 - Blindfire
  M5 - Infernal Eternal
  M6 - The Stand
  M7 - Unaligned and Unapologetic
  M8 - Pinkies and the Brain

  M9 - ?
